question: Which publisher has the highest average rating?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM Publisher p JOIN Book b ON b.publisher_id = p.id JOIN Review r ON r.id = b.review_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 1;
answer: The publisher with the highest average rating is Penguin Books.
